Competitive.name: Competitive
Competitive.description:
🏆 You need to win. You train harder than your rivals, keep score and take the bait of any challenge.

💪 Rivals drive you, and you train past exhaustion to stay ahead.
⚠️ Losing stings and it shows, and you turn shared tasks into contests.
⚠️ A rival's taunt can pull you off a plan, and you may chase a personal win when the team needs support.

📈 Grants: Conditioning +5
Competitive.traitNarrativeEffects: The character measures themselves against others: grades, times, rankings, who lifted more, who made the rescue. Rivals drive them, and they train past exhaustion to stay ahead. Weakness: losing stings, and it shows. They take the bait of any challenge, turn shared tasks into contests and may chase a personal win when the team needs support. A rival's taunt can pull them off a plan. The narrator gives them rivals worth beating and moments where winning and doing the right thing point in different directions. The narrator puts each challenge in front of them; whether they take it is the player's decision.
